problem solving.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“automated the intake and triage of vulnerability reports” vs “write a great deal of Python, particularly for the automation and analysis role.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“led security reviews of services I did not write” vs “keeping an engineering team honest”","dimension":"security assessment orientation","description":"This captures the extent to which the candidate presents themselves as someone who evaluates systems for weaknesses and performs security-minded review.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“capture-the-flag competitions regularly” and “OSCP certification” vs “capture-the-flag ... built a simple personal finance tracker”","dimension":"offensive security depth","description":"This captures the strength of hands-on security practice beyond general interest, including certifications or adversarial training.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“incidents that never occur” vs “quiet resilience rather than visible spectacle”","dimension":"tone toward impact","description":"This captures whether the letter frames its appeal in highly preventative, incident-avoidant language or in broader quiet-reliability language.","winner":"A"}]}
